info.title: Work Master API
info.description: Implemented Phase 1 authentication and Phase 2 authorized reads. Public invoice and payment mutations remain planned. Production requires HTTPS; see docs/api/README.md. Phase 4 adds draft creation, separate submission and one-invoice receipts with required idempotency keys. Existing website pricing and posting rules remain unchanged. Operators may temporarily disable all API traffic: HTTP 503 api_disabled preserves committed records and credential state.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque mobile access or integration token; reject ambiguous cookie/bearer authentication.

token.description: Shown only in this issuance response; never retrievable later.

inventory_timestamp_policy.description: Present when controlled inventory is active. Document dates and posting_time do not set inventory movement time.

inventory_posted_at.description: Authoritative server-generated inventory movement timestamp. Null for drafts and legacy records without a controlled posting event.

item_code.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

quantity.description: Positive decimal, maximum 99999999999.999; zero is rejected.

unit_price.description: Nonnegative decimal, maximum 999999999999, up to six decimal places. Rates retain precision; each quantity × rate line amount rounds to whole UGX, half away from zero.

warehouse.description: Optional line warehouse; otherwise uses the invoice warehouse. Subject to the same warehouse permissions.

customer_id.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

warehouse.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

price_list.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

invoicer_id.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

cost_center.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

invoice_date.description: With controlled inventory active this is documentary metadata; the server assigns inventory movement time on submission.

posting_time.description: With controlled inventory active this is documentary metadata; the server assigns inventory movement time on submission.

notes.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

discount_amount.description: Nonnegative decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding applies.

tax_amount.description: Nonnegative decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding applies.

non_system_invoice.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

check_stock.description: Legacy compatibility flag. Every draft create/edit checks combined quantities per item/warehouse against current and selected-date stock, later stock minima, and permanent reconciliation cut-offs before saving. Omission or false does not disable validation. Saving does not reserve or post stock.

InvoiceCreate.description: Creates a draft without receipts or stock reservation. All lines use the required header warehouse. Names and snapshots come from current master records. UGX rates/amounts follow existing whole-unit rounding; quantities retain three decimals. Omitting posting_time uses server Kampala time when first committed; retries retain the original result.

amount.description: Positive decimal, maximum 999999999999; existing whole-UGX rounding must leave a positive receipt. Amount cannot exceed the current balance including qualifying journal allocations.

account_id.description: Positive safe-integer string. Active permitted asset Cash/Bank account; method is derived by existing posting.

external_source.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

external_reference.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

notes.description: Trimmed string without NUL; surrounding whitespace is rejected.

PaymentCreate.description: One submitted invoice per receipt. Source/reference permanently protects this account independently of credential rotation, ordinary key expiry or website cancellation. No new uniqueness rule on website payments.

inventory_timestamp_policy.description: Present when controlled inventory is active. Document dates and posting_time do not set inventory movement time.

inventory_posted_at.description: Authoritative server-generated inventory movement timestamp. Null for drafts and legacy records without a controlled posting event.

PaymentMutationResult.description: Original receipt and parent database IDs. Read invoice/payment endpoints for current status and amounts; cancellation never reactivates a receipt.

InvoiceCompany.description: Company display information shown on the main invoice, included only after invoice visibility checks.

ApiError.description: Error envelope; status determines category. Retry-After required for throttling; never expose SQL errors or stack traces. HTTP 503 also covers API containment (api_disabled); clients retain keys/references and reconcile after service resumes.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one header, 1–128 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Stable account/operation/resource key. Identical validated payload replays original committed status/body for seven days; changed payload conflicts. Current authorization is rechecked. Failed pre-commit validation or posting does not consume the key. Reconcile draft creation after expiry. Permanent payment references survive expiry.
